title: Toshiaki Yamada's Tokyo Duel Manga Ends
content: Coamix 's Comic Zenon + manga website published the final chapter of Toshiaki Yamada 's Tokyo Duel ( Tokyo Kettō Kanjōsen ) manga on September 23. The final chapter became free to read on Wednesday. Coamix publishes the manga volumes in English digitally.

title: Monster Hunter Rise Game Sells 20 Million Copies Worldwide
content: The official X/Twitter account for CAPCOM 's Monster Hunter franchise announced on Friday that the Monster Hunter Rise game has surpassed 20 million copies sold worldwide. Monster Hunter Rise launched on Nintendo Switch in March 2021 and then launched on PC via Steam in January 2022.
author: ANN

title: K Manga Adds Sen Sen Senki Manga
content: Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Tuesday that it will add author A-10 and illustrator Ryūga Kawasaki's Sen Sen Senki manga on October 13. A-10 and Kawasaki debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine on June 10. Kodansha published the first compiled book volume on September 16.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Anime Streams in India on October 11
content: Crunchyroll announced on Monday that it will simultaneously stream the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus television anime series in India on October 11. The anime will stream in Japanese with English subtitles. Netflix will stream the series in India beginning on October 14.
author: ANN
